title: The feedback inbox skips echoes of commands the owner ran
why: Every echo of a command the owner ran, and every long paste, needs a hand-written feedback item, which blocks turns for text that is not an instruction.
source: owner 21:59 CST Nov 12, Q7 a (store entry inbox-skip-bash-echo)
note: Ship a: the feedback guard skips bash-input echoes. The owner is open to b, one item covering a run of messages, "if done right": only a run with no ruling, grant or question word in it, each message still listed under the item. Decision owner-feedback-inbox is the home. Lane 22:42 CST Nov 12: #3076 ships option a only. Owner prose typed after `!` runs as a shell command, so its echo is skipped and never saved (round 3: low harm). Unmeasured: whether a prompt with only bash-stdout blocks reaches the hook; it would be saved. Closes with a real `!` run.
